description: Fetch the complete JECFA record for one substance by its chemical id: chemical and synonym names, CAS and INS numbers, functional class, and every safety evaluation JECFA has made of it — evaluation year, ADI, the committee’s conclusions, dietary exposure findings, meeting number, and the TRS report and toxicological monograph citations. Use after search to explain how and when an ADI was set or revised.
